## Displacements and Seismic Coefficients {#sec-newmark_results}

The displacement figures shade the damage thresholds of Chapter [-@sec-criteria] as bands of $D_n/H$ at `r paste(.fmt(DAMAGE.CUTS, 1), collapse = ", ")`% of the slope height, and the coefficient figures shade the same thresholds on the $D_a/H$ axis; each demand tab groups the material–geometry combinations for one return period or the MCE, with colors for materials and line patterns and widths for geometries.

### Newmark Displacement Curves {#sec-dn-curves}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .reportHeading(
    .reportSite(SiteTable, i, "dn-curves", list(), "Newmark displacements"),
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 4L,
    anchor = "sec-newmark-curves-site",
    context = "Newmark displacements",
    kind = "multisite"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/Dn.qmd",
    stem = "dn-curves",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    root = root,
    context = "Newmark displacements"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
